decisive_items: well‐defined hyperpigmented, hyperkeratotic plaques with thick adherent scales
hyperkeratosis, parakeratosis, focal subcorneal clefting with keratinocyte necrosis
response.rationale: Biopsy findings and clinical morphology are classic for psoriasis; hypothyroidism and low-normal zinc are incidental and not supported by specific skin biopsy features.

rejected.why: Elevated TSH explains systemic hypothyroidism but not the specific psoriasiform histology or peripheral erythematous rim.
Zinc is only lower-end normal and no acrodermatitis enteropathica pattern or supportive biopsy findings are present.
